name: WE_EncryptorSetup
title: The WE encryptor's own l-succinct LWE setup (B, W, T) and the leaf lemma's setup kernel
description: AdvancedEncryption.WE.EncryptorSetup: bits (binary decomposition for Def_SuccinctLWE's gadget), Wof (W = [A | H - V], H = gadget (ln) k q), dOf (the short preimage map [R x; x] of [A | H - A R]), floodT (each column of T by flooding y + [0; d(t - [I (x) B | W] y)]), encLaw (the encryptor's (B, W, T): B uniform without trapdoor, W with a gadget trapdoor, T by flooding) and chalLaw (Def_SuccinctLWE's (B, W, T)); for the leaf lemma: idxB, idxW (row indices of the blocks of T), leafSetup (B -> (row blocks of a uniform W, T <- trapdoorLaw)), leafGood (T exists with entries at most E), leafTB, leafTW (the blocks T_B[i,j], T_W[j] mod q).
